verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ENSUNU nga bw'eweevuuma,
Ne yeegomba amazzi,
Bwe bagiyigga ewala-ennyo,
Bwe ntyo bwe nsinda nze.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Neegomba-amzzi g'obulamu
Agava waggulu;
Omwoyo ne gunnuma nnyo
Okunywa,nzikute.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ka ngume omwoyo;Yesu
Ye wa kisa kyonna;
Taalemenga kunsanyusa,
Bwe ngumiikiriza.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Eri Katonda Kitaffe,
N'Omwana we Yesu,
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
Esaanidde ettendo
